summary.text: Julia Reed is a Democratic member of the Washington House of Representatives, representing District 36-Position 1 since January 2023, and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.

paragraphs.text: Julia Reed was born in Redmond, Washington.
She earned a bachelor's degree from Smith College in 2009 and an MPA from Princeton University in 2017.

Reed's career experience includes working as a social impact consultant for Kinetic West, in the Obama administration at the State Department's Political Military Affairs Bureau and the Office of Management and Budget, and as a senior policy advisor to the mayor of Seattle.
She has served as a board member of the YMCA Social Impact Center and FUSE Washington and is a former chair of the 36th LD Democrats.
Reed assumed office in the Washington House on January 9, 2023.
